figure: Figure 11.4 — Three accelerator paths and one qualification gate (caption)
issue: Caption grammar/number error in the legend explanation: 'dashed enclosure group each column' is missing number agreement — should be 'dashed enclosures group each column' (or 'a dashed enclosure groups each column'). The parenthetical '(dashed enclosure = complete path)' should be updated to match whichever number is chosen.
evidence: Exact caption clause, PDF p.217 / printed p.197: 'Solid arrows denote dependencies; dashed enclosure group each column (dashed enclosure = complete path), and dashed arrows bring the complete path to the qualification gate.' Semantic content of the caption otherwise matches the drawn figure (three four-level columns, solid within-column dependency arrows, dashed column enclosures, three dashed arrows converging on one red qualification-gate box) and matches the italic note's five-item gate list (memory residency / operator coverage / correctness + isolation / collectives if used / measured SLO).
acceptance_test: Caption clause reads with corrected number/agreement and the parenthetical updated to the same number; no other caption text changed; re-render shows no reflow that detaches the caption from the figure.

figure: Figure 11.4 — in-figure legend (subtitle under 'Device visibility is not a validated serving path')
issue: The in-figure legend 'Solid: dependencies. Dashed: qualify the complete path.' does not account for the dashed column enclosures. Under an arrow-only reading (parallel to 'Solid: dependencies', which covers only solid arrows), the dashed box around each column has no legend entry at all; under an all-dashed reading, the enclosure is misdescribed, because the enclosure groups/marks a complete path and does not 'qualify' anything — only the dashed arrows submit the path to the gate. A reader decoding the figure from its own legend cannot determine what the dashed box means and must be rescued by the caption ('dashed enclosure = complete path').
evidence: In-figure subtitle, PDF p.217 / printed p.197: 'Solid: dependencies. Dashed: qualify the complete path.' vs. caption: 'dashed enclosure group each column (dashed enclosure = complete path), and dashed arrows bring the complete path to the qualification gate.' No other in-figure text explains the dashed enclosures (the bottom in-figure note reads only 'Conceptual dependency map. No cross-device API or feature equivalence implied.').
acceptance_test: Legend distinguishes the two dashed elements, e.g. 'Solid: dependencies within a path. Dashed box: complete path. Dashed arrow: path submitted to the gate.'; re-rendered figure shows no overlap, clipping, or caption reflow after the edit.

issue: Caption-to-figure semantic mismatch on gate structure: caption states 'three conditional candidates, each with its own open validation gate' but the figure groups candidates (a) and (b) into a single shared 'OUTCOME — THROUGHPUT GATE' box and gives only (c) a separate quality-gate box. No candidate has 'its own' gate in the drawn layout.
evidence: Caption: 'three conditional candidates, each with its own open validation gate (not a settled verdict)'. Figure outcome row: left box 'CAPACITY SCREEN: (a) · (b) pass … THROUGHPUT GATE', right box 'QUALITY GATE (c)'. Candidates (a) and (b) share one gate box; (c) has a distinct box. The word 'each' implies three separate gate boxes.
acceptance_test: Either revise caption to 'candidates (a) and (b) share a throughput gate; candidate (c) awaits a quality gate' or redraw the outcome row with three per-candidate gate boxes.

issue: Caption names three gates 'MEM/THR/QUAL (memory fit · throughput at the SLO · quality)' but the figure labels the memory gate as 'CAPACITY SCREEN' rather than any MEM/memory-fit label. A reader mapping caption acronyms to figure boxes cannot find a box labeled MEM or memory-fit; the mapping CAPACITY SCREEN → MEM is unstated.
evidence: Caption: 'all tested against the same MEM/THR/QUAL gates (memory fit · throughput at the SLO · quality)'. Figure: left outcome box header reads 'OUTCOME — THROUGHPUT GATE' with sub-line 'CAPACITY SCREEN: (a) · (b) pass'. No box or label contains 'MEM' or 'memory fit'.
acceptance_test: Either add 'MEM' or 'memory fit' as a visible sub-label inside the capacity-screen box, or change the caption acronym list to match the figure's own gate names (CAPACITY/THR/QUAL).

issue: Grayscale distinguishability: the four stacked boxes use blue (requirements), orange (constraints), green (candidates), green (outcome), orange (quality gate). In grayscale the blue and green fills render as similar mid-tones and the two orange fills are identical. Structural labels (①②③④?) and distinct text provide redundancy, so the figure remains interpretable, but the color coding carries no independent grayscale signal.
evidence: Rendered page at 150 dpi: box fills are light blue, light orange, light green, light green, light orange. Converting to grayscale yields closely spaced mid-tones for blue vs green and identical tones for the two orange boxes.
acceptance_test: Convert figure to grayscale; verify that box roles remain distinguishable from fill tone alone or that a non-color cue (border style, icon, or explicit role tag) compensates. Current text labels partially compensate — confirm sufficiency at print size.
